```{r}
wetlands <- rast("../../../courses/EDS223/NCOS_Ortho.tif")
```

```{r}
names(wetlands)
```

Band 1 - Blue; Band 2 - Green; Band 3 - Red; Band 4 - Red-Edge; Band 5 - Near Infrared

```{r}
names(wetlands) <- c("Blue", "Green", "Red", "Red-Edge", "Near Infrared")
print(names(wetlands))
```

```{r}
# True color image
plotRGB(wetlands, r = 3, g = 2, b = 1, stretch = "lin")
```

Along with true color image, calculate and plot NDWI.

- NDWI: Normalized Difference Water Index
    - Normalized difference between green and nir bands

```{r}
# NDWI function
ndwi_fun <- function(green, nir){
    (green - nir) / (green + nir)
}
```

```{r}
ndwi_rast <- lapp(wetlands[[c(2, 5)]], fun = ndwi_fun)
names(ndwi_rast) <- "ndwi"
```

```{r}
plot(ndwi_rast)
```
